job.job_description:
Roles and Responsibilities :

Design, develop, test, and deploy AI-powered solutions using AIMl to improve business processes and customer experiences.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify areas for improvement and implement data-driven insights from machine learning models.
Develop and maintain complex algorithms, ensuring scalability, reliability, and performance of AI systems.
Stay up-to-date with industry trends in AI technology and recommend innovative solutions to drive business growth.

Job Requirements :

6.11-16 years of experience in IT Services & Consulting as an Artificial Intelligence Engineer or related field.
Strong proficiency in Python programming language with expertise in developing AI applications using various libraries such as TensorFlow or PyTorch.
Experience working on large datasets to extract valuable insights through statistical analysis or machine learning techniques.
